text: Añade un descuento por cupón al carrito: el cupón DESC10 resta un 10 % del total y hay que validar que el código existe. Toca src/cart.js y src/index.js, añade el test en test/cart.test.js y descríbelo en README.md.

Corrige el cálculo de impuestos del carrito, que redondea mal los céntimos, y añade tests que lo cubran. El cambio va en src/cart.js y src/index.js, los tests en test/cart.test.js y la nota en README.md.

Add coupon support to the cart: the code SAVE10 takes 10% off the total, and unknown codes must be rejected. The change touches src/cart.js and src/index.js, with a test in test/cart.test.js and a note in README.md.
Fix the tax calculation in the cart, which rounds cents wrongly, and add tests that cover it. The fix goes in src/cart.js and src/index.js, the tests in test/cart.test.js and the note in README.md.

Build a complete ordering system for the shop from scratch: a persistent cart, checkout with payment, order history and a REST API.
Migrate the shop to a modular architecture with an SQLite database, user authentication and an admin panel.
